Sera Starride is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is the main operator of the Administrations Office of the Akras Summoners' Hall in the Imperial Capital Randall.

==Debut Appearance==
First appeared in the Imperial Capital Randall, Sera explains the various information about the Administration Office. Much later, she will explain the basics of the [[Achievement System]].

==In the storyline==
While not a part of the main storyline, in the epilogue of [[GQ:Lin|Lin's Long Day]], the Summoner and Karl bumped into her by accident and suddenly glares at the Summoner. This is mostly the spreading rumors of the "incident" after the Summoner saves Lin Merylham from a bomb attack that took the Summoner's clothes naked.

In [[GQ:Noah|Hopes and Regrets]], she along with Elise and Lin took on a camping trip during their dayoff to know more about Elise. She is typically silent but often agrees with Lin.

==Personality==
Sera is often portrayed as a rather serious character nonetheless, as she is in charge of the Administration Office.

==Abilities==
While not really a fighter by any natural means, a Mock Unit modeled after Sera was created, although its abilities are unclear.

Her notable ability is to create two blue lightsabers and attack with them.
